milestone: Milestone 8: Institutional Data Acquisition and Evidence Intake

datasets.title: Telangana Directorate of Economics & Statistics Annual Rainfall (Hyderabad)
datasets.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), Government of Telangana
datasets.access_restrictions: Open Government Data / Official Statistical Abstract. Annual district summary.

temporal_coverage.resolution: Annual and Seasonal (SW Monsoon, NE Monsoon)

datasets.provenance_notes: Official published statistical abstracts benchmarked across 19 representative historical years including extreme monsoon deluges (2000, 2016, 2020, 2022).

datasets.title: Telangana State Development Planning Society AWS Rainfall Telemetry
datasets.publisher: Telangana State Development Planning Society (TSDPS), Planning Dept, GoTS
datasets.access_restrictions: Daily summary bulletins and web maps are publicly viewable. Programmatic automated extraction and sub-daily/hourly raw time-series require formal institutional credentials, written data-sharing agreements, and departmental clearance.

temporal_coverage.resolution: 15-minute / Hourly AWS sensor readings (institutional only); daily bulletins (public)

spatial_coverage.resolution: Point AWS telemetry (~100+ stations across GHMC mandals)

datasets.provenance_notes: Public portal reports daily totals. Individual event peaks (e.g. 320 mm at Ghatkesar in Oct 2020) are verified and captured within the SafeMap Historical Flood Catalogue.

datasets.title: ISRO / NRSC Bhuvan Flood Inundation Assessment: Hyderabad October 2020
datasets.publisher: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
datasets.access_restrictions: Public disaster portal displays WMS/WFS map viewer layers and damage assessment PDF reports. Raw full-resolution GeoTIFF inundation rasters require authorized ISRO/NRSC credentials and formal requisition.
datasets.license: ISRO / NRSC Open Geospatial Portal (Non-commercial Disaster Management Use)

spatial_coverage.region: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation & Musi River Floodplain

datasets.provenance_notes: Mapped open-water ponding extent after Deep Depression BOB 02. Optical/SAR resolution captures 7 major submergence corridors along Musi River and lake cascades.

datasets.title: NDMA SACHET National Disaster Alerting Network (Hyderabad Historical Alerts)
datasets.publisher: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Government of India
datasets.access_restrictions: Public emergency CAP warning portal. Historical warnings archived by State Disaster Management Authorities (TG-SDMA).
datasets.license: Public Emergency Warning Protocol (Free Public Access)
datasets.provenance_notes: Official Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) bulletins for heavy rainfall, reservoir discharges, and low-level causeway closures along the Musi River.

datasets.title: SafeMap AI Curated Hyderabad Historical Flood Event Catalogue (1908–2023)
datasets.publisher: Compiled and Curated by SafeMap AI from Official Multi-Agency Records
datasets.access_restrictions: Open research dataset compiled from official public publications.

spatial_coverage.region: Hyderabad Metropolitan Area, Musi River Basin
spatial_coverage.resolution: Event-specific urban sector and causeway references

datasets.provenance_notes: Audited historical flood catalogue capturing 8 major urban flood events (1908, 2000, 2008, 2016, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023) with event-level provenance, explicit measurement classifications (OBSERVED, SECONDARY_REPORTED, ESTIMATED, UNVERIFIED), and audit trails.

datasets.title: Copernicus GloFAS Musi River Discharge Simulation (October 2020)
datasets.publisher: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) GloFAS via Open-Meteo
datasets.provenance_notes: Hydrological model simulation. Explicitly classified as MODEL_FORECAST. Must not be substituted for physical stream gauge observations.

datasets.title: Hyderabad Published Flood-Prone Vulnerability Zones GeoJSON
datasets.publisher: GHMC Disaster Management Cell & MRDCL Surveys (Curated by SafeMap AI)

spatial_coverage.region: Musi River Corridor & Urban Nala Basins

datasets.provenance_notes: Static topological vulnerability polygons. Flooding within these zones is contingent on gate releases and storm drain capacity; presence of polygon does not indicate real-time water level.

datasets.title: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis Meteorological Parameters: Hyderabad October 2020
datasets.publisher: ECMWF / Copernicus Climate Change Service via Open-Meteo Historical Archive

temporal_coverage.resolution: Hourly reanalysis aggregated to daily metrics

datasets.provenance_notes: Atmospheric reanalysis estimates. Captures the extreme precipitation peak of 13-14 October 2020.
